title: RewardHarness: Self-Evolving Agentic Post-Training
abstract: Aligning generative models with human preferences remains a central challenge. While RLHF is widely adopted, it relies on large-scale preference data. This limitation is particularly evident in evaluating instruction-guided image edits, even though humans can often learn such preferences from only a few examples. We present RewardHarness, a training-free, self-evolving agentic reward framework that reframes reward modeling as context evolution rather than weight optimization. Instead of learning from large-scale annotations, RewardHarness aligns with human preferences by iteratively evolving a library of tools and skills from as few as 100 preference demonstrations. Given a source image, an edited image, and an editing instruction, an orchestrator agent selects the most relevant subset of tools and skills from the maintained library, and sub-agents invoke them to construct a reasoning chain that produces a reward score. By comparing predicted scores with ground-truth preferences and analyzing successes and failures in the reasoning process, the orchestrator automatically refines its library of tools and skills without additional human annotation. Using only 0.05% of the EditReward preference data, RewardHarness achieves 47.4% average accuracy on EditReward-Bench K=2/3/4 and GenAI-Bench, surpassing GPT-5 by 5.3 points. When used as a reward signal in FlowGRPO, RL-tuned models achieve 3.52 on ImgEdit-Bench. Code and model are available at the project page: https://rewardharness.com/

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2605.08703v2 的 18 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：available。
analysis.ideaZh: RewardHarness 将 image-edit preference learning 从更新 reward-model weights 改为演化可读的 Skills/Tools library：orchestrator 用 100 个偏好样例分析错误并按 held-out improvement 接受修改，冻结 VLM 执行评价。作者报告更好的 edit ranking 与 FlowGRPO editor training；亮点是低数据、可检视 reward context，尚未验证 3D/结构设计迁移及 API 成本。
analysis.motivationZh: instruction-guided image edits 的 human preference reward 通常依赖大规模偏好标注和模型 finetuning，适配成本高且评价过程不透明。
analysis.methodZh: RewardHarness 将 image-edit preference learning 从更新 reward-model weights 改为演化可读的 Skills/Tools library：orchestrator 用 100 个偏好样例分析错误并按 held-out improvement 接受修改，冻结 VLM 执行评价。作者报告更好的 edit ranking 与 FlowGRPO editor training；亮点是低数据、可检视 reward context，尚未验证 3D/结构设计迁移及 API 成本。
methodFlow: orchestrator 路由 rubric skills 与 visual-analysis tools
冻结 VLM 生成分项证据与候选排名
对照 human preferences 分析失败并提议 library edits
validation 严格改善才提交，最终冻结 library 作为 editor RL reward
analysis.experimentsZh: EditReward 训练 split100 样本，独立 EditReward-Bench 和 GenAI-Bench；FLUX.2-klein-base-4B+FlowGRPO；测试 Qwen 与 Gemini subagents。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告 Qwen subagent 的平均准确率 45.7%，相同 backbone EditReward42.0%；同 FlowGRPO editor 的 ImgEdit-Bench overall 从 3.32 到 3.52，EditReward 为 3.45。（Table 1, p. 6; Table 2, p. 8） 对照范围：与 proprietary VLMs、EditReward 等比较，并控制同 backbone 和同 RL 算法；系统含强 orchestrator，数据量优势不等于总成本更低。 消融与诊断：Fig. 6 分析 77 轮 evolution 与 pruning，附录给 library composition；缺少完整多 orchestrator 成本和能力对照。
analysis.insightZh: 用 context/library evolution 取代 reward model finetuning；工具在此多为 VLM 执行的 procedural specification，非独立训练的视觉 detector。
analysis.evidenceZh: Skills 是 declarative rubrics，Tools 是 targeted visual analysis 的文档化程序。（Secs. 2.2-2.4, pp. 4-5; Fig. 2, p. 3）；candidate library 仅在约 30 held-out demonstrations 的准确率严格提高时保留，最终 library 有 3skills+4tools。（Sec. 2.5, pp. 5-6）；作者报告 Qwen subagent 的平均准确率 45.7%，相同 backbone EditReward42.0%；同 FlowGRPO editor 的 ImgEdit-Bench overall 从 3.32 到 3.52，EditReward 为 3.45。（Table 1, p. 6; Table 2, p. 8）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 低数据、可审计的视觉 reward context 为生成模型反馈提供不同于普通指标微调的 post-training 路径。
analysis.caveatZh: 依赖 capable orchestrator；API cost、latency 与不同 backbone tradeoff 未系统刻画。；主要限 instruction-guided image edits，video/3D 与其他生成任务尚待验证。；约 30 验证样例反复门控存在 selection overfitting 风险；作者避免 reward hacking 的宽泛结论不能由单表完全证明。；public implementation 已确认含 evolution、evaluation 与 benchmark Python modules，但本项目未运行复现。
